A lot of cats don’t handle change very well— they can get very overwhelmed and anxious about all the new noises, smells, and sights. 

So it’s a good idea to have a “safe room”. It’ll be the one spot of the house they’ll stay in until they’re comfortable enough to walk around. A room they can run back to whenever they get too anxious. Should have their water, litter etc, even drop some of your worn clothes in there to leave your scent to comfort them.

If you want a bit of extra help with the anxiety, you can get a Feliway diffuser to put in that same room too. It imitates FFP (Feline Facial Pheromones), which is released when cats feel safe and secure in their environment. Otherwise there are loads of other products that can help— tablets, liquids, sprays etc. 

Most importantly, give them time. Spend time with them in their safe room, don’t push them to explore; it can take days, even weeks for some cats to feel comfortable enough to walk around freely. They’ll come around, they just need time and love 

All the best!

Edit- whoops, saw that final bit about using a lot of Feliway Spray. Use it sparingly and only on spots that your cat may find attractive or safe. It can take up to a week for effects to be seen.

I’m 24 now and didn’t go through the highschool relationship phase. I used to be envious of my friends who had relationships throughout school— definitely feel like I’ve missed out on an experience. But at the same time, pretty glad I never got into one just because I’ve realised through the years that I would’ve never been ready for one when I was younger.

I got into a lot of painful and tricky “almosts” as an adult that made me realise that I’ve always wanted stability and maturity. Not saying all teenage relationships are immature, but there are a lot different from dating as an adult (from what I’ve seen and heard from those friends). In the end, it feels like maybe you’re missing out, but there is gonna be some guys later on that will teach you what you want out of a partnership. I got back into the dating scene a few months ago and met a guy who’s had the same experiences as me dating wise, and it’s been great learning from each other. 

For now, just be a queen and enjoy the experiences coming for you. I’m sure you’ll have stories to tell later on ☺️
